description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing subscription statuses within the Opencart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting subscription status entries, as well as preparing views with appropriate data and handling user permissions.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Controller class for handling CRUD operations and views related to subscription statuses in the Opencart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point to display the subscription status list page with header, footer, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the subscription status list view; primarily used for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML for the list of subscription statuses, including pagination links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a subscription status, with data pre-filled if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to add or update subscription statuses, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription statuses after permission and dependency checks, with error reporting.
